name: Bewitchment figurine pierced with needles, 3rd–4th century
note: Unfired clay figurine of a nude female with bound arms, kneeling, pierced with copper needles (about 12 survive, out of 13 in the accompanying text). It is a love-spell (defixio) figure from Egypt, said to have been found with a lead curse tablet in a small ceramic jar. About 9.6 x 4.2 cm.
credit: Musée du Louvre, Département des Antiquités égyptiennes, E 27145
